name: GAN 249 V2 M
description: The GAN 249 V2 M the magnetized version of the GAN 249 V2. This 2x2 speed cube features a honeycomb design on the corner contact points and an overall smooth feel. The Stickerless version features a bright stickerless color scheme, primary plastic internals, while the black plastic version features the GAN Full Bright color scheme and black plastic internals.
